catalog.revision_note: swappable helms on 1.6 mm D-flat pegs
catalog.description: Swappable helm designs for the Vigilant troopers, each named by identifier: VH-01 Vigil, VH-02 Warden, VH-03 Breacher, VH-04 Seeker, VH-05 Sentinel, VH-06 Raptor, VH-07 Diver, VH-08 Hunter, VH-09 Bulwark, VH-10 Specter. Every helm has the same 1.6 mm D-flat neck peg, so any helm fits any trooper.
buildNotes: Defined in tools/armory.py (HELMS registry); built by tools/bitspack.py.
Lens and visor recesses are at least 0.25 mm deep; crests and fins at least 0.7 mm thick.
catalog.limitations: Procedural designs; printability is a heuristic screen (unified-CAD-MCP), not a test print.
